nodes.label: Standalone Components Constraint
nodes.rationale: All Angular components must use standalone:true; no NgModules allowed

nodes.label: Angular Material Requirement
nodes.rationale: Use Material components for all UI; no raw HTML where equivalents exist

nodes.label: Constructor Injection Pattern
nodes.rationale: All Spring dependencies injected via constructor, never field injection

nodes.label: Layering Architecture
nodes.rationale: Controllers → Services → Repositories; DTOs on wire, not entities

nodes.label: Flyway Migration Immutability
nodes.rationale: Existing migration files are never modified; new changes require new V{n} files
